    Deck transformations for star models #

    Proof of Proposition 4.1, Step 3 (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex), for the repetition of a star model Δ covering a finite stable translation quiver Q by π:

    "For each z with π z = π o, construct a map H_z : R → R over π by sending o to z, lifting the rooted tree edges, and extending by translation and mates. Since Δ is a tree, these choices are consistent."

    Here o is the centre at height 0; the rooted tree edges are the arms.

                        theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.StarDeck.deck_cyclic {t : ℕ} (L : Fin t → ℕ) {V : Type u} [Quiver V] [∀ (x y : V), Subsingleton (x ⟶ y)] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} (hQ : Q.IsStable) (π : (starTree L).ZVert ⥤q V) (hπ : π.IsCovering) (hτ : ∀ (Y : (starTree L).ZVert), π.obj ((starTree L).ztau Y) = hQ.tauE (π.obj Y)) (ht : 0 < t) (hcl : t = 1 ∨ t = 3) (hnt : ∃ (X : (starTree L).ZVert) (Y : (starTree L).ZVert), X ≠ Y ∧ π.obj X = π.obj Y) :
                        ∃ (z₀ : (starTree L).ZVert) (hz₀ : π.obj z₀ = π.obj (o L)), 0 < z₀.t ∧ ∀ (X Y : (starTree L).ZVert), π.obj X = π.obj Y ↔ ∃ (l : ℤ), (deck L hQ π hπ hτ ht z₀ hz₀ ^ l) X = Y
